outcome: Phototherapy treatment requirement for neonatal hyperbilirubinemia
cohort: 1,109 neonates born in 2018 in an academic hospital in Regensburg, Germany, born at or after 34 weeks gestation and with at least two total serum bilirubin (TSB) measurements prior to phototherapy.
finding: The early phototherapy prediction tool (EPPT) accurately predicted phototherapy treatment requirement for neonatal hyperbilirubinemia in a new patient cohort with an AUROC of 84.6% for the original model and 88.8% for the retrained model.
